description: Mines the current (or a described) coding session for friction and hard-won knowledge, then fixes it at the source instead of just writing it down: saves a repeatable trap to this project's `.claude/memory/` as a `gotcha`, or hands off to `skill-report` when the devkit itself should have caught the mistake. Use when the user says "capture what we learned", "do a retro", "write this down for next time", "what would make this faster next time", or after a session that involved real digging or more than one wrong turn.
